theater_event_25_02_08_337:
My, my, what a delicious-looking "dream."
I'll gobble it right up this instant.
theater_event_25_02_08_339:
—Magical Girl Sunny Smile, was it?
Bring it on. I'll crush that hope of yours.
theater_event_25_02_08_341:
Shut the hell up!
Quit yappin' and get on with it!!
theater_event_25_02_08_343:
Heh—thanks for the assist.
Lovely Blue, we'll keep handling you!
theater_event_25_02_08_345:
—What's with all this scribbling everywhere?
It's overflowing with "dreams." How vile.
Rubbish like this should be wiped out.
theater_event_25_02_08_346: I'll never let you do that!
theater_event_25_02_08_347:
No matter how hard it got,
she never gave up on the things she loves!
I won't let you erase that "dream"!
theater_event_25_02_08_348:
—But nobody wants it. Keep this up,
and no one will pay you any attention.
You'll only ruin yourself.
theater_event_25_02_08_349:
That's not true! Even if the whole world
didn't want it...I love the "world"
this girl drew!
theater_event_25_02_08_351:
And then—yeah! It'll all work out for sure!
That's how it went for us too, right?
theater_event_25_02_08_354:
—Hey, Teach. Tiona...er, Sunny Smile said
she's on yer side no matter what.
theater_event_25_02_08_355:
She meant every word of that.
I feel kinda the same way...
Is that a bother to ya, after all?
theater_event_25_02_08_357:
Gotcha. Then I'll fall for yer work
all I want. Stick with me a bit longer, 'kay?
theater_event_25_02_08_358:
Ahaha! Tione...wait, no.
Dark Apostle Jormungandr! Thank you!
theater_event_25_02_08_359:
Thanking your enemy? Your head's rotten!
Always grinning like an idiot.
What a disgusting magical girl!
theater_event_25_02_08_360:
Okay! But Magical Girl Sunny Smile
puts a smile on even her enemies' faces!
theater_event_25_02_08_361:
—Sunny Smile!
Your transformation brooch is fixed!!
theater_event_25_02_08_362:
Thanks! Okay then—one more time!
Here I goooooooo!!
theater_event_25_02_08_363: Let the light shine, let smiles sparkle—
theater_event_25_02_08_364:
—I'll cast a smile spell on you☆
Magical Change, Sunny Smile!!
theater_event_25_02_08_365: Lovely Blue! This time for sure!
theater_event_25_02_08_367:
Rain down, love! Burst forth, smiles!
Lovely Smile—Magical Sunriiiiise!!
theater_event_25_02_08_371:
...Means it hit the audience right in the
heart. The essence of yer "magical girl," kiddo.
theater_event_25_02_08_372:
The Daydreamer—ya might not like it, kiddo,
but I think it's a great name, y'know?
theater_event_25_02_08_373:
Daydreams so big they shower everyone
watchin' with "dreams"...
That'd be amazin', if ya could pull it off.
theater_event_25_02_08_375:
Hey! What'd you think?!
I wanted to bring the "world" you drew
to life. So I gave it a shot!
theater_event_25_02_08_377:
...I'm...so...happy...
Everyone watched the magical girls...
and smiled...
theater_event_25_02_08_378:
Yup! 'Cause it's super fun!
Your magical girl!
theater_event_25_02_08_380:
No matter what, when you were making
your magical girl, I bet you were
having fun. So—!
theater_event_25_02_08_381: Hold your head high and smile!
theater_event_25_02_08_382:
No matter how much they mock you or
laugh at you! Just curl your lips up!
theater_event_25_02_08_384: Hehe~! I knew you'd get it!
theater_event_25_02_08_387: Tch... I'm never doin' this farce again...
theater_event_25_02_08_388:
Oh? You were surprisingly natural at it.
The small-fry villain werewolf.
theater_event_25_02_08_390:
No more pushin' yerself to be somethin'
ya ain't. Flaunt the talent ya got.
theater_event_25_02_08_391:
And when ya feel like it, draw the rest
of that "magical girl," yeah? Everyone...
every last person here is waitin'.
theater_event_25_02_08_392:
...I'll definitely draw it...
No matter what anyone says...
I won't lose anymore.
theater_event_25_02_08_393:
Yeah!
As long as you've got a strong heart
that believes and keeps going!
theater_event_25_02_08_394:
Allll right! Then tell me what happens next!
C'mon, let's go eat some Jyaga Maru-kun
over there while you do!
theater_event_25_03_01_002:
Even the omniscient, omnipotent gods
cannot travel to the past or the future.
theater_event_25_03_01_003:
Ah, all is the great vortex, the divine
work of Chaos. Before primordial chaos,
even the gods are helpless.
theater_event_25_03_01_004:
Some, poisoned by boredom, tried anyway...
and every last one was ground to dust.
The end.
theater_event_25_03_01_005:
The past cannot be changed,
and the future is not set.
That is the "premise."
theater_event_25_03_01_007:
Suppose there were someone with "luck"
that had nothing to do with divine power.
theater_event_25_03_01_008:
Say, someone who slipped into a crack
in the earth, bound for a sea of magma—
theater_event_25_03_01_009:
—only to stray into an ant's nest
as twisting as a labyrinth—
theater_event_25_03_01_010:
Like a rabbit led by his beloved Alice
all the way to the far side of the world.
theater_event_25_03_01_011:
If someone that "lucky" existed,
then at one in a hundred million,
one in a trillion...one in an infinity...
theater_event_25_03_01_012:
Even if Chaos sneezed and he got caught
in the resulting rift in space-time,
he might reach another time entirely.
theater_event_25_03_01_014:
In short, what I'm about to tell you
is the story of a boy who crossed time.
theater_event_25_03_01_017:
Whaaat? How?
I went to sleep in my room
at home last night—
theater_event_25_03_01_018:
Wha...?! An explosion?!
It came from over there!
theater_event_25_03_01_024:
What's going on?!
Why is Orario a sea of flames...?!
theater_event_25_03_01_025: ...Obviously, because this is the Dark Era.
theater_event_25_03_01_027:
More importantly, you. How do you know
my true name?! Are you an agent
of the Evilus?!
theater_event_25_03_01_028:
Whaaat?!
I-I mean, you're Ms. Ryu, so...!
theater_event_25_03_01_029: We've known each other for ages—
theater_event_25_03_01_030: ...Ms. Ryu? When did you grow your hair out...?
theater_event_25_03_01_031: My hair? What are you going on about?!
theater_event_25_03_01_033:
There was still someone who didn't get out?
Are you okay?
theater_event_25_03_01_034:
Alise.
This man, his behavior is somehow...
theater_event_25_03_01_035:
Alise...?
That name... Isn't she...Ms. Ryu's...
theater_event_25_03_01_036:
Oh, you know who I am?
Hmm-hmm! Of course you do, I'm famous!
theater_event_25_03_01_037:
In that case, I'll introduce myself
even though you didn't ask! Pure, just, and
beautiful—Level 3 Alise Lovell!
theater_event_25_03_01_041:
What's going on?! It's the Dark Era, and
the Astraea Familia?! Why?! Whyyyy?!
theater_event_25_03_01_042:
Lion, what's wrong with him? He's so
confused it's pitiful. Like a rabbit that
slipped on a cloud and fell into a pit!
theater_event_25_03_01_043:
I don't really understand either...
But he's certainly suspicious.
theater_event_25_03_01_044:
Heeey! Alise, Lion!
What are you doing?!
theater_event_25_03_01_046:
We're short on hands, and you two are
dawdling around?
theater_event_25_03_01_047:
No doubt the honorable elf over there
held you back. She charges in like a boar
every time and only makes more work.
theater_event_25_03_01_048: Don't mock me, Kaguya! Who's a boar?!
theater_event_25_03_01_049:
Ugh, how tiresome. The claims of an elf
whose only virtue is her pride.
Still wet behind the ears.
theater_event_25_03_01_051:
(Ms. Lyra and Ms. Kaguya...?
 I'm pretty sure they were also
 in the Astraea Familia...)
theater_event_25_03_01_052: (And five years ago, along with Ms. Alise...)
theater_event_25_03_01_053:
So what were you doing?
We already finished off the enemies here.
theater_event_25_03_01_054:
There's a kid who didn't escape, but he
seems a bit confused. He's been acting—
theater_event_25_03_01_056:
What's today's date...
I-I mean, what year is it...
in the Age of Gods?
theater_event_25_03_01_057: Huh? What's this guy on about?
theater_event_25_03_01_058:
I don't really get why you're asking,
but the current year is—
theater_event_25_03_01_059:
Just maybe...
With that thought I asked, and their
answer was a shock.
theater_event_25_03_01_060: The answer they gave was seven years ago.
theater_event_25_03_01_061:
They said, clear as day, that we were in
the middle of the "Dark Era"—
theater_event_25_03_01_063:
Hey, you...are you really okay?
Your face has gone a terrible color.
theater_event_25_03_01_064:
I don't know what happened, but...
for now, we'll take him in for questioning—
theater_event_25_03_01_065:
An explosion?!
There are still Evilus scum around?!
theater_event_25_03_01_066:
Tch, maggots spreading destruction...
Let's go!
theater_event_25_03_01_068:
No way a dope with a face like that's
with the Evilus! Hurry up!
theater_event_25_03_01_069:
Ngh... It can't be helped.
You there, human, flee at once!
theater_event_25_03_01_070:
There's a shelter up ahead!
You're not hurt, so you can make it
on your own, right?
theater_event_25_03_01_072:
Then I'm counting on you!
Don't worry, we'll beat the bad guys!
theater_event_25_03_02_001:
The "Dark Era"... After we came back from
the deep floors, Ms. Ryu told me
all kinds of things—
theater_event_25_03_02_002:
It was a terrible time. Everyone was hurt
and drowning in grief, yet they kept
fighting on...
theater_event_25_03_02_004:
Of course. We clashed again and again with
the Evilus, the faction of darkness.
theater_event_25_03_02_005:
Seven years ago, there was a great battle
known as the "Great Conflict."
theater_event_25_03_02_006:
And five years ago, the Astraea Familia
was wiped out...all but me...
theater_event_25_03_02_008:
It was a truly painful, agonizing time.
That's not the only reason, but...
I'm glad you came to Orario as it is now.
theater_event_25_03_02_010: You're pure, and far too kind.
theater_event_25_03_02_011:
If you'd strayed into Orario back then,
you would surely have been badly hurt.
I never want to see you like that...
theater_event_25_03_02_012:
That's what Ms. Ryu said, but...
have I gone and strayed right into it?
theater_event_25_03_02_014:
This is a dream, right? It has to be...
But do people you've never seen
show up in dreams?
theater_event_25_03_02_015:
I still don't get it...
What should I do...?
theater_event_25_03_02_016:
What's wrong? Standing still
in a place like this.
theater_event_25_03_02_018:
I'm Astraea.
It's a little embarrassing to say,
but I'm a goddess.
theater_event_25_03_02_021:
Y-yes. She's saved me so many times,
I owe her my life... She's someone
really precious to me.
theater_event_25_03_02_022:
Hee-hee, how lovely.
To think Ryu has someone like that.
theater_event_25_03_02_023: Then shall we talk for a bit?
theater_event_25_03_02_025:
You're in some kind of trouble, aren't you?
Right now you look like a lost child.
theater_event_25_03_02_027:
Ryu had that same look when I first met her.
You two are alike. Earnest, a bit clumsy,
and very kind.
theater_event_25_03_02_028:
If something's troubling you, tell me?
I might be able to help.
theater_event_25_03_02_029:
...This might sound really weird.
Is that okay?
theater_event_25_03_02_031: I'm pretty sure this is my "dream," but...
theater_event_25_03_02_032:
...So for you, this is the world
of seven years ago.
theater_event_25_03_02_033:
...What Familia are you in?
And your name?
theater_event_25_03_02_034:
The Hestia Familia...
I'm Bell Cranel.
theater_event_25_03_02_036:
No one in the mortal world could know
the name of a god still in the heavens.
Then he truly crossed a rift of Chaos...?
theater_event_25_03_02_037:
...? Um, Lady Astraea?
You believe me? What I'm saying...?
theater_event_25_03_02_038:
...Yes. You're not lying. Besides, once
you bring up Hestia's name,
I can hardly not believe you.
theater_event_25_03_02_040:
No need to thank me.
More importantly, Bell,
what do you want to do now?
theater_event_25_03_02_042:
You called this a "dream," and you're not
wrong. If anything happens, this world and
we will vanish before you like phantoms.
theater_event_25_03_02_043:
But it's also true that you must stay here
until you wake from that "dream."
theater_event_25_03_02_044:
(That's...true. All five senses are sharp,
 and pinching myself hurts.
 It doesn't feel like I'm about to wake...)
theater_event_25_03_02_045:
So I want to make sure. In this world,
which may be a nightmare,
what do you want to do?
theater_event_25_03_02_046:
...If this "dream" really is the world
of seven years ago for me...
...then I want to stay a little longer.
theater_event_25_03_02_048:
Seven years ago... For Orario, and for
Ms. Ryu and the others, it was so painful...
theater_event_25_03_02_049:
But I heard it was still precious to them.
So if I'm allowed...I want to know
what happened here.
theater_event_25_03_02_050:
...Very well. In the name of the goddess
Astraea, I grant it. Your stay, the first
traveler through time ever observed.
theater_event_25_03_02_052:
(So divine, like I've received a blessing—
 I'll probably never forget meeting
 this goddess as long as I live—)
theater_event_25_03_02_053:
Well then, from now on
you're our "freeloader"♪
theater_event_25_03_02_055:
You've got nowhere to eat or sleep, right?
So you can just stay at our home.
theater_event_25_03_03_001:
Finally done.
Making us work for it, those Evilus bastards.
theater_event_25_03_03_002:
Still, back home to our base! A triumphant
return! Lady Astraea should be back
by now too.
theater_event_25_03_03_003:
Yes, we should hurry and put
Lady Astraea's mind at ease—
theater_event_25_03_03_005:
Wh-who are you calling greenhorn
all of a sudden, Kaguya?!
theater_event_25_03_03_006:
Fool, pay attention. Someone's in the manor.
Two someones.
theater_event_25_03_03_007:
...!
One must be Lady Astraea. And the other...!
theater_event_25_03_03_008:
It can't be Neze and the others. They're
outside the city on a long-term quest.
They won't be back for a while.
theater_event_25_03_03_009:
Then it's some thug holding Lady Astraea
hostage, huh?
theater_event_25_03_03_010: ...Guess somebody wants to get killed, huh?
theater_event_25_03_03_011:
Lyra, circle around back.
The three of us will storm the front.
theater_event_25_03_03_012:
We'll draw the enemy's attention, so you
keep Lady Astraea safe. Ready?
3, 2, 1—
theater_event_25_03_03_016: He's subdued! Is Lady Astraea safe...?!
theater_event_25_03_03_021:
Yes, for certain reasons I've decided to
look after him for a little while.
He's a very good boy, so it's fine.
theater_event_25_03_03_022:
Even if you call him good... Are you sane,
Lady Astraea?! Bringing such a suspicious
man into the Familia?!
theater_event_25_03_03_023:
I'm Alise Lovell! This is Lion, and that's
Kaguya and Lyra! Nice to meet you,
mysterious boy!
theater_event_25_03_03_024:
Aliiiiise...!
Don't introduce yourself like
nothing happened!
theater_event_25_03_03_025:
It's fine, Lion! Lady Astraea said he's
"fine," didn't she? He's surely pure and
just of heart, even if not as much as me!
theater_event_25_03_03_026:
Waste of time, Lion. It's not gonna get
overturned. Besides, folks down here
can't lie to the gods anyway.
theater_event_25_03_03_027:
Nor does this dopey face look like one
capable of scheming.
theater_event_25_03_03_029:
Or what? Are you saying
you can't trust Lady Astraea?
theater_event_25_03_03_030:
N-no, nothing of the sort!
But living under the same roof as a man...!
theater_event_25_03_03_031:
What a pointless worry,
you closet-pervert elf.
theater_event_25_03_03_032: Don't call me a closet perveeeeeert!!
theater_event_25_03_03_033: (W-wow... I've never seen Ms. Ryu like this...)
theater_event_25_03_03_034:
What is it, brat?
Has my accursed beauty driven you mad?
theater_event_25_03_03_035: Y-you?! So you DO look at us that way...!
theater_event_25_03_03_036: Huh?! No, no, that's not it?!
theater_event_25_03_03_037:
Um, well...M-Ms. Kaguya?
You just seem...different from
when we first met...!
theater_event_25_03_03_038:
—My, my? Do you prefer this side of me?
Truly, gentlemen are so very fond
of the demure Far Eastern maiden.
theater_event_25_03_03_039:
Huh, ah...yes, I guess I like people
who seem gentle... Hahaha...
theater_event_25_03_03_041:
As if I'd waste charm on a snotty brat!
I can't stand men like you! Remember that!!
theater_event_25_03_03_042:
That's way too big a change?!
U-understood!
theater_event_25_03_03_043:
Hey, we're getting nowhere. Freeloader,
hurry up and tell us your name.
Ain't fair that only you know ours.
theater_event_25_03_03_045:
Sorry, Bell.
Could you avoid giving your true name?
theater_event_25_03_03_047:
There should be another "Bell Cranel" in
this world besides you... I'd like to
remove any seeds of confusion I can.
theater_event_25_03_03_048:
(I-I don't really get it, but she
 wants me to use a fake name?)
theater_event_25_03_03_049:
(But just like with Wiene,
 I'm not good at that kind of thing...!)
theater_event_25_03_03_050:
(Should I borrow Lili's or Welf's name?
 But that'd be kinda rude to them...!)
theater_event_25_03_03_051:
What are you whispering about?
So you DO have a guilty conscience!
theater_event_25_03_03_052:
(Aaaah! I'm out of time!
 S-something around me...!)
theater_event_25_03_03_053:
(The Goddess's knife, my Firebolt magic,
 my Argonaut skill—!!)
theater_event_25_03_03_060: It is nothing but a fake name.
theater_event_25_03_03_061:
What a breathtakingly terrible liar
you are. Mr. Fake Name?
theater_event_25_03_03_063:
Go easy on him, everyone. I said he has
his reasons, didn't I? While he's here,
he's Al... Please be good to him?
theater_event_25_03_03_064:
Understood, Lady Astraea!
Nice to have you with us, Al!
theater_event_25_03_03_065:
Eh, I'll put up with ya.
Don't make trouble, got it?
theater_event_25_03_03_066:
Try anything strange and I'll cut you down,
Lady Astraea's guest or not.
Remember that.
theater_event_25_03_03_067:
Ah, yes...
P-please go easy on me...
theater_event_25_03_03_069:
Quit being a sore loser, prissy elf~
Just give up already.
theater_event_25_03_03_072:
Ah, um...
Nice to meet you, Ms. Ryu.
theater_event_25_03_03_073:
I don't recall permitting you my true name!
And why do you know it in the first place?!
theater_event_25_03_03_075:
I told him earlier.
I'm sorry, Ryu.
theater_event_25_03_03_076:
Lady Astraea...!
Even so, he's far too familiar!
theater_event_25_03_03_077:
Unlike with Alise and the others, he looks
at me differently! Something about
this man is off!
theater_event_25_03_03_078:
My, my, "he looks at me differently," is it?
How very self-conscious of you.
theater_event_25_03_03_079:
Go easy on her, Kaguya.
Lion's an elf, and she's at that age~
theater_event_25_03_03_081: Ms. Ryu's being treated like a toy...
theater_event_25_03_03_082:
Lion is like the baby of the family to us.
We just can't help doting on her.
theater_event_25_03_03_083: Al, if you like, call her "Lion" too?
theater_event_25_03_03_085:
(She isn't the "Ms. Ryu" I know. She's
 fourteen, the same as me now...
 She's "Ms. Lion.")
theater_event_25_03_03_087:
...I don't like it! I really don't like it!
What's with that look, like you're
watching a little cousin?!
theater_event_25_03_03_089:
Why are you laughing?!
Answer my question!
theater_event_25_03_03_092:
Alise, Kaguya, Lyra! Even Lady Astraea!
Please stop laughing!
theater_event_25_03_03_093:
Th-this is regrettable! Most regrettable!!
Why is everyone laughiiiing?!
theater_event_25_03_04_001:
An empty room... They even gave me
a room of my own.
theater_event_25_03_04_002:
(This is seven years ago... But it's a
 "dream." It must be... It might all be my
 imagination, a hallucination... Even so...)
theater_event_25_03_04_003:
...When was the last time
I stayed up this late...?
theater_event_25_03_04_005: Al, are you still up? It's Alise.
theater_event_25_03_04_006: Ms. Alise...? I'll open the door!
theater_event_25_03_04_007:
Sorry for coming so late at night.
May I come in?
theater_event_25_03_04_008:
Huh? Sure, but...
I-I am a guy, you know...
theater_event_25_03_04_009:
It's fine! You wouldn't do anything
weird, would you, Al?
theater_event_25_03_04_010:
And even if my overwhelming beauty gets you
all hot and bothered, I'll go wild until
Kaguya and the others arrive! *Wink!*
theater_event_25_03_04_011:
Hahaha...
Okay. Come on in, then.
theater_event_25_03_04_013:
...No sign you've lain on the bed. As a great
detective, I saw right away that you
hadn't been sleeping, but...
theater_event_25_03_04_014:
Couldn't you sleep?
Don't tell me you were already
hot and bothered?
theater_event_25_03_04_015: I was not hot and bothered!!
theater_event_25_03_04_016:
...It's not that I couldn't sleep...
It just feels like I shouldn't.
theater_event_25_03_04_018:
Like if I fall asleep...
I'll wake up from this "dream"...
theater_event_25_03_04_019:
A "dream"...?
You're awake, but you're dreaming?
theater_event_25_03_04_020:
Ah, no, um.......please forget it.
More importantly, didn't you need
something from me?
theater_event_25_03_04_021:
Hmm, I'm not quite convinced...but fine!
Actually, there's something I want
to ask you!
theater_event_25_03_04_022:
Lady Astraea has never brought home
some boy she didn't know before!
theater_event_25_03_04_023:
So I'm super curious about you! You must
have something precious, enough for
Lady Astraea to approve of you!
theater_event_25_03_04_025: So I want to hear it.
theater_event_25_03_04_027:
Justice...?
That's kind of sudden... Hmm, hmmmm?
theater_event_25_03_04_028:
Don't overthink it.
It can just be something
you think is "right."
theater_event_25_03_04_029: I want to hear what you think.
theater_event_25_03_04_031:
(Saying "Ms. Ryu" is probably no good...
 Something I thought was right, huh...)
theater_event_25_03_04_035: Thank you? What do you mean?
theater_event_25_03_04_037:
When I look someone who helped me in the eye
and properly say "thank you"...
they smile at me.
theater_event_25_03_04_039:
Seeing that smile makes me happy too,
and I end up smiling... Both the helper
and the one helped get to smile...
theater_event_25_03_04_040:
Lately I've started to think "thank you"
might be a kind of magic words...
theater_event_25_03_04_042:
Ah...I'm sorry! That was a weird thing
to say! That's not about justice at all...!
theater_event_25_03_04_044:
No, it's good! Really good!
That's wonderful, Al!
theater_event_25_03_04_046:
You're right! "Thank you" is the most
beautiful phrase there is!
theater_event_25_03_04_047:
If there were more heartfelt "thank yous"
with no ulterior motives, the world would
become richer and happier!
theater_event_25_03_04_048: It's built on piling up what's "right"!
theater_event_25_03_04_050:
I do! That's amazing, Al! I've figured it
out! Why Lady Astraea brought you here!
theater_event_25_03_04_051: Hey, when are you joining our Familia?
theater_event_25_03_04_052:
Whaaat?! I-I'm not joining!
I have my own Familia...!
theater_event_25_03_04_053:
Aww, really?
Well, if you change your mind,
just say the word!
theater_event_25_03_04_054:
Even if Kaguya and the others object,
I'm the captain, so I'll persuade them
with burning passion!
theater_event_25_03_04_055:
I don't think you should be burning
anything...
theater_event_25_03_04_056:
Hee-hee! I'm glad I got to talk with you!
Good night!
theater_event_25_03_04_057:
So that's Ms. Alise...
She's full of energy, kind of amazing...
theater_event_25_03_04_058:
Just like Ms. Ryu said...
She's like the sun.
theater_event_25_03_05_001:
*Yawn*... Breakfast duty's such a pain~
Hurry back already, Maryu and the rest.
theater_event_25_03_05_005:
What's with this tasty-looking grub?
You got up before me to make it?
theater_event_25_03_05_006:
I ended up not sleeping last night...
I figured I'd at least do this to thank
you for letting me stay.
theater_event_25_03_05_007:
...You're pretty handy. Got somebody
you cook for or something?
theater_event_25_03_05_008:
Yes! There's the goddess of my Familia,
so I've studied cooking a little.
theater_event_25_03_05_009:
Gotcha. Then this is thanks for covering
breakfast duty. Have one of my candies.
Here.
theater_event_25_03_05_011: ...Mm, it's not too sweet. It's good...
theater_event_25_03_05_012: I'm gonna take a little of this soup.
theater_event_25_03_05_013:
Ah, sure, go ahead!
I hope it suits your taste...
theater_event_25_03_05_014:
Color's fine, nothin' weird about the smell.
I'll check the ingredients with an item...
Utensils look okay too.
theater_event_25_03_05_015:
Ms. Lyra...?
What are you doing?
theater_event_25_03_05_016: Can't you tell? Checking for poison.
theater_event_25_03_05_017: Poison?! I-I didn't put any poison in!
theater_event_25_03_05_018:
Even if Lady Astraea brought you home,
I can't trust you a hundred percent
from the get-go.
theater_event_25_03_05_019: Eh, call it a habit. Cut me some slack.
theater_event_25_03_05_021: Yeah. I was born in the City of Sinners.
theater_event_25_03_05_022:
Gettin' betrayed by allies was normal,
and so was gettin' betrayed by harmless-
lookin' types like you.
theater_event_25_03_05_023:
Th-the City of Sinners...?!
There's a place like that?!
theater_event_25_03_05_024:
..........Haaah. You're just like Lion.
Can't tell a lie. Makes suspecting you
feel downright stupid.
theater_event_25_03_05_025:
Huh? Huh...?
What are you talking about?
theater_event_25_03_05_026:
We ain't a bunch of softies.
We suspect people, and we stay on guard.
theater_event_25_03_05_027:
But you casually blab that you belong to
a Familia, show how naive you are...
Totally killed my buzz.
theater_event_25_03_05_029:
Yep. By the way, that candy I gave you
had a paralytic in it.
theater_event_25_03_05_031:
Won't do much to an upper-class adventurer
with Immunity. At Level 2 your fingertips
go numb; at Level 3 you feel nothin'.
theater_event_25_03_05_032:
So now I know you're an idiot, but
you're at least Level 3.
theater_event_25_03_05_034:
Seems you got your reasons, so I won't dig
any further, but learn to doubt people
a little.
theater_event_25_03_05_035:
Or small-time crooks like me
will eat you alive.
theater_event_25_03_05_036:
(Ms. Lyra... She's a Prum just like Lili,
 but she's way sharper, and she
 doesn't leave any openings...)
theater_event_25_03_05_037:
(Ms. Ryu said she relied on her,
 and I think I get why...)
theater_event_25_03_05_038:
Geez, lookin' after Lion's more than
enough. What am I even doin'...?
theater_event_25_03_05_039:
...Hey, let's bring out breakfast.
The noisy captain's about to wake up.
theater_event_25_03_05_041:
That was delicious! You're pretty good
at cooking too? Not bad, Al!
theater_event_25_03_05_042:
Ngh...
It's galling, but I must acknowledge
your culinary skill.
theater_event_25_03_05_044:
Um, what should we do about Ms. Kaguya's
food? It looks like she's not here yet...
theater_event_25_03_05_045:
You can just leave it.
I think she's just asleep in her room.
theater_event_25_03_05_046:
Go wake her up, freeloader.
She's vicious when she first wakes up.
theater_event_25_03_05_048:
...I'll go too.
To keep an eye on this man, just in case.
theater_event_25_03_05_050: Is Ms. Kaguya not a morning person?
theater_event_25_03_05_051:
She said she'd be drinking under the moon
last night, so that's probably why.
Honestly...
theater_event_25_03_05_052:
But that's so Kaguya!
Oh, that's Kaguya's room.
theater_event_25_03_05_053: Ah, looks like she's coming out right now—
theater_event_25_03_05_058:
Kaguyaaaaaaaaa?!
What happened to your clothes?!
theater_event_25_03_05_059:
I'm wearing something down below,
am I not?
theater_event_25_03_05_061: It's hot today. I'll stay like this a while.
theater_event_25_03_05_062:
You will not!!
There's a man here right now!
Get dressed this instant!
theater_event_25_03_05_063:
This is our home, is it not?
Why should I care about a greenhorn's
wandering eyes?
theater_event_25_03_05_065:
Mmph! These are clothes and.........
P-p-pant...?!
theater_event_25_03_05_068:
Don't worry, Al!
I wash my own panties! Hmm-hmm!!
theater_event_25_03_05_070: Hurry up and go wash them, freeloader.
theater_event_25_03_06_001:
Hah, hah...! I tossed the clothes
and ran out of there...
But there's no way I could do that...!
theater_event_25_03_06_002: Heeey, you! You with the white hair!
theater_event_25_03_06_004:
Yup, you, the one who looks like a rabbit!
I've got something to ask you.
Is that okay?
theater_event_25_03_06_006:
Me? I'm the little sister of THE Shakti
Varma, model of good conduct, never
without a smile—
theater_event_25_03_06_007:
Level 3 of the Ganesha Familia!
Ardee Varma! Ta-daaa!
theater_event_25_03_06_008: I-I didn't ask for all that, but...
theater_event_25_03_06_009:
(Wait, Ardee...? That name, I'm pretty
 sure—)
theater_event_25_03_06_011:
Yes. Ardee taught me that. It's my very hope.
She was in a different Familia, but
she was someone I could call a friend.
theater_event_25_03_06_013:
...Yes. She also lost her life in the
battle seven years ago.
theater_event_25_03_06_014:
She tried to save a girl and was caught
in the enemy's self-destruct device...
theater_event_25_03_06_016:
Had she lived, many lives would surely have
been saved. And my own fate would likely
have been different—
theater_event_25_03_06_017:
(Blue hair, eyes of the same color...
 No doubt about it! She matches
 what Ms. Ryu told me!)
theater_event_25_03_06_018:
Didn't you just come out of the Astraea
Familia's home? That's a maidens' garden,
no men allowed, you know...
theater_event_25_03_06_020:
A thief?! No!
I'm a freeloader they're looking after...!
theater_event_25_03_06_021:
Freeloading at Lion's place?
I wonder about that~
theater_event_25_03_06_029:
So he really is a freeloader?
Lady Astraea?
theater_event_25_03_06_030:
Yes, Ardee. So let him go?
Him having Kaguya's underwear was...
something like a sad accident.
theater_event_25_03_06_031:
Lady Astraea, I'm so sorry...
for making you come get me.
Um, where are Ms. Lion and the others...?
theater_event_25_03_06_032:
They went on patrol around the city.
These are the times we live in.
theater_event_25_03_06_033:
I see, so I jumped to conclusions.
Sorry, Mr. Freeloader?
theater_event_25_03_06_034:
But you shouldn't wander around town
holding panties, okay?
theater_event_25_03_06_036:
Still, a white-haired human named Al...
You're kinda like Argonaut!
theater_event_25_03_06_037:
Huh, Ms. Ardee...
You've read the Argonaut side stories?
theater_event_25_03_06_038:
That bit's only in "The Wiche Fragments,"
which was written down from oral
tradition, right?
theater_event_25_03_06_039:
Whaaat! You know it?!
That book is super old, and it's not even
considered official!
theater_event_25_03_06_040:
My grandpa loved them...
He read me tons of heroic tales
when I was little.
theater_event_25_03_06_041: Wow~! This makes me so happy!
theater_event_25_03_06_042:
Whenever I say, "It's really deep,
so read it closely!" nobody listens~!
theater_event_25_03_06_043:
They're all like, "Argonaut's just
a fairy tale~"!
theater_event_25_03_06_044:
Well, Argonaut is kind of a comedy,
so I get how they feel...
theater_event_25_03_06_045:
For that era, I like Epimetheus
better too.
theater_event_25_03_06_046:
The guardian of Olympia! But by my analysis,
Argonaut looked up to Epimetheus!
theater_event_25_03_06_047:
I mean, "the Dullard" and "the Fool"!
He must've been influenced by him!
theater_event_25_03_06_048:
Now that you mention it, in his final lion
hunt, Argonaut sang the song of heroes,
didn't he?
theater_event_25_03_06_049:
You know that too?!
I've never met anyone like you before!
theater_event_25_03_06_050:
Hey, hey!
Let's have one of those "otaku talks"
the gods always go on about!
theater_event_25_03_06_051:
So anyway, I think this nasty fortune-
teller is a key figure!
theater_event_25_03_06_052:
Some books leave her out, but I get the
feeling she's someone connected
to Argonaut!
theater_event_25_03_06_053:
Um...I always figured this fortune-teller
was the one who wrote Argonaut's story...
theater_event_25_03_06_054:
Whaaaaaat?! W-wait a sec!
That would change my whole interpretation!
theater_event_25_03_06_055:
This goes there, and that goes here...
A-amazing! You're way too amazing!!
theater_event_25_03_06_056:
You two really know your stuff.
The sun's already gone down.
theater_event_25_03_06_057:
Ah...sorry, Lady Astraea!
We were the only ones talking!
theater_event_25_03_06_058:
It's fine. It was fun to listen to,
and I've never seen Ardee get
this excited before.
theater_event_25_03_06_060:
...Hey.
Can I call you Al from now on too?
theater_event_25_03_06_062:
Then, Al! Let's talk again sometime!
I want to talk with you more—
theater_event_25_03_06_064:
An explosion?!
That's...from the factory district!
theater_event_25_03_06_067:
I'll be fine; I can evacuate on my own.
Do as your heart tells you.
theater_event_25_03_07_003: Sorry we're late! What's the damage?!
theater_event_25_03_07_004:
...The Evilus have already been wiped out.
No one died. But shielding the civilians...
Lyra got hit.
theater_event_25_03_07_006:
What, Al...? Don't come over here...
Not while I'm lookin' this lame...
theater_event_25_03_07_007:
Lyra, you mustn't talk!
I'll cast healing magic now!
theater_event_25_03_07_009:
(Ms. Lyra's wounds are so deep... It's
 a wonder she's alive... And the others too...
 even the city itself...)
theater_event_25_03_07_011:
—The battle seven years ago began with
an attack on the industrial district.
theater_event_25_03_07_012:
The Evilus were after the hammer mechanisms
in magic-stone products. Combined with
flame stones, they made vicious bombs.
theater_event_25_03_07_013:
The "Seven Days of Death"...
Many people died during that
Great Conflict.
theater_event_25_03_07_015:
I'd already told Lady Astraea the stories
Ms. Ryu told me.
theater_event_25_03_07_016:
There were parts I didn't understand, but
I told her everything I could... Including
that Ms. Alise and the others died.
theater_event_25_03_07_017: If I really have come to the past...
theater_event_25_03_07_018:
I thought maybe there could be a future
where Ms. Ryu didn't have to grieve.
theater_event_25_03_07_019:
But I was naive. I told Lady Astraea I
wanted to know what happened here,
but I wasn't ready.
theater_event_25_03_07_020:
I...hadn't tried to become someone
who was actually part of it.
theater_event_25_03_07_022:
...What brings you here so late at night,
Bell?
theater_event_25_03_07_023: There's something I need to ask you...
theater_event_25_03_07_024:
If this really is the "past" for me,
and if I saved Ms. Ardee, and Ms. Alise
and the others...
theater_event_25_03_07_025:
What do you think would happen to
the "future"...to the world I came from?
theater_event_25_03_07_026:
...About the world you must return to,
I know nothing.
theater_event_25_03_07_027:
But our world would certainly diverge from
the "past" you know.
theater_event_25_03_07_028: Those who should have died would live on—
theater_event_25_03_07_029:
And those who should be there might
disappear.
theater_event_25_03_07_031:
Ryu might never work at the tavern, and walk
on with Alise and the others... A future
where she never crosses paths with you.
theater_event_25_03_07_032:
...If we and Ms. Ryu were strangers, the
Hestia Familia's fate...and the futures of
everyone Ms. Ryu saved...
theater_event_25_03_07_033:
There's no way to see the "future." It's all
speculation. So I won't question your
sense of justice here.
theater_event_25_03_07_035:
Then decide whether to act or to watch.
No one will blame you—
theater_event_25_03_07_036:
Change the "past"...?
Even if it changes the "future"...?
theater_event_25_03_07_039:
What's with that bloodless face?
Planning to join the dead?
theater_event_25_03_07_041: Can I ask you something weird?
theater_event_25_03_07_043:
If you could change the "past"...
what would you do, Ms. Kaguya?
theater_event_25_03_07_045: You could protect people you couldn't save.
theater_event_25_03_07_046:
But because of that, something might
change so much you can't undo it...
theater_event_25_03_07_047:
If that happened, Ms. Kaguya...
what would you do?
theater_event_25_03_07_052:
I despise that sort of idiotic talk
more than anything!!
theater_event_25_03_07_053:
Discarded ideals, choices we failed to
make—none of it can ever be taken back!
theater_event_25_03_07_054:
It makes me sick! You wretched slave
to regret!!
theater_event_25_03_07_056:
Ahh, infuriating...! From the first time
I saw you, I couldn't stand you!
theater_event_25_03_07_057:
You fool, greener than even Lion!
Don't show me illusions with those eyes!
theater_event_25_03_07_061: What's the rest of it? Out with it.
theater_event_25_03_07_062:
Wh-why? You said you hated this kind
of talk...
theater_event_25_03_07_063:
I do, with a passion. But throwing a tantrum
won't make that gloomy face in front of me
disappear.
theater_event_25_03_07_064:
Pull yourself together this instant and
never show me that unpleasant face again.
Go on, say it.
theater_event_25_03_07_065:
Y-yes...! Um...
If you'd gone back to the "past,"
Ms. Kaguya—
theater_event_25_03_07_068:
Does this hypothetical assume
you've already gone back to the past?
theater_event_25_03_07_069:
Y-yes, it does. That's how it is...
About seven years back...
theater_event_25_03_07_070:
Wasn't it about whether to go back or not...?
Bah, don't mislead me! You dolt!
theater_event_25_03_07_071:
Owww?!
H-hey, don't kick me! I'm sorryyy?!
theater_event_25_03_07_072:
How stupid after all.
There's only one answer!
theater_event_25_03_07_074:
The moment that person goes back to the
"past," that world is no longer the "past"!
It's the "present"!!
theater_event_25_03_07_076:
Seven years ago or five years ago, to that
imbecile it's all one continuous "now"!
theater_event_25_03_07_077: "If I act, a bad 'future' might await"?
theater_event_25_03_07_079:
A better future will never come to those
who don't live the "present" to the fullest!!
theater_event_25_03_07_081:
Save those you can save now, and act wisely
so there are no more sacrifices next time!
That's all there is to it!
theater_event_25_03_07_083: Doing everything I can, right now.
theater_event_25_03_07_084:
That's what we can do, since all we can do
is live in the present.
theater_event_25_03_07_085:
That must be...the one "justice" anyone
can put into practice.
theater_event_25_03_07_088:
That you're strong and strict...
but more than anyone, you never compromise
on what's "right." That you're straight.
theater_event_25_03_07_089:
What are you talking about...?
Lion would never say such a thing...
theater_event_25_03_07_090:
Thank you, Ms. Kaguya.
I'm heading out!
theater_event_25_03_07_093: His face is no longer a greenhorn's.
theater_event_25_03_07_094:
From that day, a mysterious force arose,
belonging to neither Orario nor
the Evilus.
theater_event_25_03_07_096:
A lone hunter who foiled Evilus attacks as if
foreseeing the future, and who stepped into
battles to back up the adventurers.
theater_event_25_03_07_097:
Wielding fire, swift as lightning. Once it
rings out, the sound of a bell scatters
all before it.
theater_event_25_03_07_098:
Countless were those protected. The evils
he defeated outnumbered all the gods'
fingers combined.
theater_event_25_03_07_099:
A hypocrite who held to his ego, he never
called himself just—and kept on running.
theater_event_25_03_08_002:
Yes, Captain Shakti! The Evilus forces
trying to break into the industrial district
were all taken down in one fell swoop...!
theater_event_25_03_08_003:
Judging from witness testimony, it was
surely the "Hunter" again!
theater_event_25_03_08_004:
How many times is this...?! One masked
unknown is plenty with Lion! We don't even
know if he's friend or foe!
theater_event_25_03_08_005:
But, Sis, I don't think he's a foe, right?
The "Hunter" only targets the Evilus...
theater_event_25_03_08_006:
He doesn't kill—just neutralizes them and
hands them to adventurers. He's like a hero
of justice from a story... It's so exciting!
theater_event_25_03_08_007:
Don't get excited! Mind the situation!
And I've told you not to call me "Sis"
in front of others!
theater_event_25_03_08_008:
...Given his actions so far, I'm close to
convinced the "Hunter" isn't opposed to
Orario. But the problem here is—
theater_event_25_03_08_009:
His track record. Judging by the forces
he's defeated, he's high Level 4 at the
very least...! He could even be Level 5!
theater_event_25_03_08_010:
...! On par with Lord Loki's and Lady Freya's
Familias...? The "Hunter" is stronger than
you, Sis, close to the city's top fighters...?
theater_event_25_03_08_011:
Neutralizing enemies instead of killing
them takes that much strength. Unknown
affiliation, unknown goals, only strength—
theater_event_25_03_08_012:
We can't rely on him carelessly. Nor can we
ignore him. Like the Evilus, we're being
jerked around by the "Hunter" too.
theater_event_25_03_08_016:
If he holds no hostility toward Orario,
why fight alone?
Just who is the "Hunter"...?
theater_event_25_03_08_017:
—"If you don't fight alone, you're terribly
inefficient as you are now."
theater_event_25_03_08_018:
If my Master were here, that's surely what
he'd say. In this world I'm an "outsider"...
I have to keep that in mind.
theater_event_25_03_08_019:
I'm suspicious. Very suspicious. Using
"future knowledge" to fight alongside
everyone would take time and restrictions.
theater_event_25_03_08_020:
So I'll let Lady Astraea use the
"future knowledge," and *I'll* be
the one who goes on a rampage.
theater_event_25_03_08_021:
Ms. Alise and the others have their roles.
I can't drag them into what I'm about
to do... I don't want to.
theater_event_25_03_08_022:
Of course, there's a limit to what one
person can do. A time will definitely come
when I need help. But for now—
theater_event_25_03_08_024:
So this is where you were! I brought the
goods you asked for, safe and sound!
theater_event_25_03_08_025:
—I never dreamed Mr. Mord would
be the one to help me out...
theater_event_25_03_08_026:
Huh? You say somethin'? Or you still
doubtin' me? Now that hurts!
theater_event_25_03_08_027:
Back when those Evilus scumbags were about
to do me in, you swooped in and saved me
in the nick of time! Your back as you did!!
theater_event_25_03_08_029:
It's still burned into my eyes! Whatever the
others say, you're my savior—no, my hero!
I'll lend you a hand as much as you want!
theater_event_25_03_08_030:
(I was surprised Mr. Mord was in Orario
 back then...but being called "Boss"?
 I'm way younger than him...)
theater_event_25_03_08_031:
(He won't listen when I ask him to stop.
 It's really weird...)
theater_event_25_03_08_032:
Besides...followin' you, Boss, I can strip
the Evilus you beat and sell their gear all
I want. I'll follow you anywhere, heh...!
